configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Settings shared by every preset below. 'hidden' means it cannot be selected on its own.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: No optimisation, full debugging information. Use this one unless you have a reason not to.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised. Much faster to run and much harder to debug, because the compiler has rearranged the code.

configurePresets.name: strict
configurePresets.description: The same as debug, except a compiler warning stops the build. Run this before handing work in.

buildPresets.name: debug
buildPresets.description: Every build preset names its configuration explicitly. Visual Studio picks Debug or Release at BUILD time rather than at configure time, so without this line 'cmake --build --preset release' would quietly build the Debug version.
